newsitem.title: USA: Logan's raises $22.4 mln in $24/shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Logan's raises $22.4 mln in $24/shr offer.

text.p: Logan's Roadhouse Inc said Wednesday it raised a net $22.4 million in a one-million share offering priced at $24.00 a share.
The restaurant operator said it intended to use the proceeds to open more restaurants and improve its existing 24 restaurants.
Logan's added it granted underwriters J.C. Bradford & Co and Equitable Securities Corp an over-allotment option of 150,000 shares.
Chief financial officer David McDaniel said he had not received word whether the underwriters had used their option.
Logan's stock traded at 24-1/2 Thursday, down 1/8.
